candidates.title: Once bitten, twice shy? How France prevented a repeat of October 17 protest chaos
Israel elections: Can Netanyahu turn security gains into a political victory?
candidates.excerpt: Israeli voters will head to the polls on October 27 in a significant election for Benjamin Netanyahu. His political future hinges on addressing security failures following the October 7 attack by Hamas. Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a primary challenger, emphasizing military accountability over Netanyahu's leadership. The election highlights divisions within the opposition and potential coalition challenges.

candidates.title: Faded Netanyahu Trails Behind Rival Eisenkot For Israel Knesset Polls
